pages.title: Lost the Race...
pages.text: "Lost the Race" is a jingle of Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994) that lasts about four seconds. By its name it belongs to the Andy Asteroids races, which Jim can lose to Psy-Crow.

pages.title: What happens next
pages.text: According to Sega Retro, if Jim loses a race in Andy Asteroids, he must fight Psy-Crow himself before the next level starts.
